info.title: MobileDoo API
info.description:
REST-style JSON API of the **MobileDoo** modules (`mobile_connector` + `mobile_hr`, `mobile_hr_*`,
`mobile_purchase`, `mobile_sale`, `mobile_stock`, `mobile_delivery_tracking`) for Odoo 16+.
It is what the MobileDoo app uses, and it can be used by third-party systems (portals, chat bots,
other ERPs, integration platforms).

## Conventions
- Every operation is `POST` with a JSON body (`{}` when empty) and answers
  `{"ok": true, "data": ...}` or `{"ok": false, "error": {"code", "message"}}` with an HTTP 4xx/5xx status.
- **Authentication**: `POST /auth/login` once, then `Authorization: Bearer <device_token>`.
  An invalid/revoked token is answered by Odoo's auth layer with **HTTP 401 and an HTML body** (not JSON).
- **Rights**: everything runs as the logged-in Odoo user (ACL, record rules, `access` capabilities).
- **Language**: `X-Mobile-Lang: fr_FR` returns labels and business messages in that language (if enabled on Odoo).
- **Values**: see `FieldValue` ("mobile format"): many2one `[id, "name"]`, dates as strings, `false` for empty.
- **Versioning**: `api_version` from `/info` (currently 1.19). Minor = backwards compatible additions;
  a different major is incompatible.
- **Browsers**: CORS is not enabled; call the API from a server.

## Integrating a third-party system
1. Create a dedicated internal Odoo user with exactly the rights the integration needs.
2. `POST /auth/login` with a stable `device.device_uid` (e.g. `erp-connector-acme`) and keep the token in a secret store.
3. Revoke it any time in *Settings > Mobile App > Devices* (or `POST /auth/logout`).
4. Prefer `/records/{service}/*` and the form spec: business rules, onchanges and customer modules apply as in Odoo.

get.description: Public. Use it to check that the module is installed (HTTP 404 otherwise) and which API version and features the site has.

post.summary: App UI strings for a language
post.description: Public. Strings of the mobile app screens (not Odoo data) for clients that render the same UI.

post.summary: Log in and get a device token
post.description:
Exchanges credentials for a long-lived, revocable token (no expiry). The token is revoked by `/auth/logout`, by an administrator (Settings > Mobile App > Devices), when the user changes password or is archived.

**Multi-database servers without dbfilter**: first call `POST /web/session/authenticate` (JSON-RPC) with `db`, `login`, `password`, then send the returned `session_id` cookie with every request: it only selects the database.

post.summary: Current user, site and access rights

get.description: Binary image (not JSON) set in *Settings › Mobile › Branding*, up to 512 px. 404 when no logo is set. Authenticated so it comes from the right database on multi-database servers. Add `?v=<site.logo>` to cache it for a long time. Since API 1.6.

Binary image (not JSON) set in *Settings › Mobile › Branding*, up to 1600 px. Public, like `/info`: the login screen shows it before anyone is signed in. 404 when none is set. Add `?v=<site.login_background>` to cache it for a long time. Since API 1.17.

post.description: FCM token of the device (null to stop push). Not needed for server-to-server integrations.

push_key.description: `site.push.key` the token was obtained for (API 1.13); none: the push gateway.

push_pubkey.description: Public key of the phone (X25519, 32 bytes in base64) for end-to-end encrypted notifications (iPhone with the push gateway, docs/push-e2e.md; mobile_connector 1.14). 400 if it is not one; cleared with the token.

post.summary: Detect changes of watched records and lists
post.description: Returns only what changed. List keys: `records.<service>.<scope>`, `core.access`, `activities.mine`, `timeoff.dashboard`, `attendance.status`, `menu.<menu_id>.<filter+filter>` (the `key` of `/menus/list`). A record no longer readable comes back with `deleted: true`.

stage_id.description: Service `crm`: only this stage (or the won ones). Other services ignore it.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description:
Record service. Modules can register more (`mobile.api._mobile_record_services`).
- `timeoff`: Time off requests (hr.leave). Scopes: mine (request), to_approve (approve), team (team). Create: request.
- `expense`: Expenses (hr.expense). Scope: mine (submit); Odoo 19+: to_approve (approve). Create: submit. Up to Odoo 18: extra button `mobile:submit` = create report + submit; Odoo 19+: Odoo's own Submit / Approve / Refuse.
- `expense_report`: Expense reports (hr.expense.sheet), up to Odoo 18 (`access.expense.reports`). Scopes: mine (submit), to_approve (approve). No create.
- `picking`: Transfers (stock.picking). Scopes: receipts, deliveries, internal (view): open transfers; the same with the suffix `_ready` (`deliveries_ready`...): only those ready to process. Buttons: validate, check availability, unreserve. No create.
- `attendance`: Attendances (hr.attendance), read-only. Scopes: mine (history), team (manage = today's attendances).
- `employees`: Employee directory (hr.employee.public), read-only. Scopes: all, department (view). Search: name, job, department, e-mail, phones.
- `purchase`: Purchase orders (purchase.order) with `lines`. Scopes: mine (view), to_approve (approve: purchase managers, orders in "To Approve"). No create.
- `crm`: Opportunities (crm.lead; module `mobile_crm`). Scopes: mine (view), followup (view: mine, nothing planned or the next step due), team (team: leaders and managers). List parameter `stage_id`: a stage id or `won` (default: open ones). Create: create. Odoo's own buttons (Won, Lost...).
- `sale`: Quotations / sales orders (sale.order) with `lines`. Scopes: mine (view), to_approve (approve: sales managers, or team leaders for their teams; open quotations). No create.

post.summary: Form of a record, or of a new one
post.description: With `id`: the record. Without: a new record with Odoo defaults (requires the create capability).

with_actions.description: Add `actions` (approve / refuse buttons of each record). One form view per row: ask for it with a page of 40 or less.

post.description: The user's Odoo Inbox, newest first: mentions and messages on followed documents. `all` adds the read ones (Inbox history). Open the record with `/form/spec` (or its native record service). Since API 1.7.
Like the web client (the web inbox and counter update too). `all: true` marks the whole Inbox read. Since API 1.7.

post.summary: Summary and buttons of any record
post.description: Any model the user can read (ACL and record rules apply). Fields: admin-configured, else a short summary of the form view. `full: true` (since 1.14): the whole form, editable (`FullFormSpec`).

`mine` (capability `view`): the employee's own confirmed payslips (done / paid, no drafts, no refunds), newest first. `all` (capability `manage`: payroll officers): every payslip the user's own Odoo rights allow, any state; `query` searches the employee, the number and the name. `year` filters by the start of the period. Requires the `payroll` feature (module `mobile_payroll` and a payroll: Odoo Enterprise or OCA).
Own confirmed payslips for everybody; anybody else's only with the user's own Odoo rights (officers). A payslip that does not exist is refused like one the user may not read.

post.summary: Note and next step on any record
post.description: A log note in the chatter of the record (what a salesperson writes after a meeting), and/or the next step: an activity scheduled for the user. At least one of `body` and `activity`. Needs the same rights as the web (write on the record); a record without a chatter is refused (400). Idempotent with `client_id`. Since API 1.19.

post.summary: Stages of the opportunities of a scope
post.description: Stages with the number of opportunities in each (the chips of the list); won stages last. Requires `crm` with the capability of the scope (`view`, `team`). Since mobile_crm 1.0.

post.summary: Run a button of any record
post.description: `record`: the record after the button, full when `full: true`.
Odoo's onchange (custom modules included); nothing is saved. Since 1.14.
Only fields the view lets the user change are written. `version` from the spec: 409 if someone saved in between. Since 1.14.

client_id.description: Id the phone makes for a request it keeps while offline: sent twice, it runs once and the repeat gets the first answer back (since 1.15).

post.summary: Click a stage of the statusbar
post.description: Refused unless the statusbar is `clickable`; the module's own stage rules apply. Since 1.14.
Odoo's defaults with the field's context (`default_project_id`...). Since 1.14.

post.summary: Search values for a cell of a line
post.description: With the column's domain (it may use the line and `parent.`). Since 1.14.
No `line_id`: a new line. Read-only cells of the line are not written. Since 1.14.
Since 1.14.

post.summary: Run a button of a line
post.description: A button of `rows[].buttons` (e.g. a checklist item's Done). Since 1.14.

post.summary: Search values for a field of any model

post.description: Open what an action returned with `type: wizard` (pass `model`, `context`, `res_id`, `view_id` as received). Send `values` + `changed` to run its onchange.

post.summary: Run a button of a wizard
Odoo apps and menus of the user
post.description: The menus the user has on the web (groups applied, admin-hidden menus removed) that open a list of records, grouped by app and section. Requires the `menus` feature.

Cards declared by the installed feature modules (waiting approvals, sales of the month against last month, people present or on leave, late deliveries...), computed with the user's own rights. Requires the `dashboard` feature with `view`, granted to those who can approve or manage something. Since API 1.18.
Mobile App > Home Screen, filtered for the user: tiles (order, labels), KPIs computed with their rights, quick actions. Since API 1.8.
Read: hidden from the user's home screen, unless mandatory. Returns the new `/home`. Since API 1.11.
For the Customize screen: show/hide (switch) and order (drag) of sections, tiles, KPIs and quick actions. `locked` blocks (admin: Always shown) cannot be hidden. Since API 1.9.

Order = list order. Blocks the user may not use are dropped, locked ones stay visible. Stored on Odoo (same on every device); `{"reset": true}` restores the default. Returns the new `/home`. Since API 1.9.
Applies the action domain, the chosen search filters and the user's rights. Open a record with `/form/spec` (or the record service of its model).

query.description: Search on the name fields of the model.

filters.description: Names of the active filters; null/absent = the action's defaults.

kpi_id.description: Opened from a home screen KPI (`/home`): only the records it counts, no default filter. Since API 1.8.

post.description: Without `id`: the user's own employee. Lists use the record service `employees`.

get.description: Binary image (not JSON) of `image_128|image_256|image_512`, with the user's rights. 404 when there is no photo (generated SVG avatars are not served). Add `?v=<image_version>` to cache it for a long time.

404.description: No photo, unknown field, or no access

post.summary: Time off balances and upcoming leaves

post.description: Toggles the state with Odoo's own check-in logic (mode systray). Location/photo may be required by the company (`require_location`, `require_photo`), and a reason (`reason_required`, OCA hr_attendance_reason). When work areas limit the employee (`geofence`), Odoo computes the distance from `latitude`/`longitude` for the check in and for the check out: in mode `block` an employee outside, or with a position too imprecise (`accuracy`), gets 400 `user_error` and nothing is written; in `warn` the check goes through and `geofence_result` says what was found.

mock.description: The phone says the position comes from a mock location app (Android `isMock`, iPhone `isSimulatedBySoftware`).

at.description: Unix seconds: when the person pressed the button, for a check kept on the phone while offline. Refused (400) when in the future or more than 24 hours old; Odoo's own rules still apply (no overlap, check out after check in). Since 1.15.

client_id.description: Id the phone makes for a request it keeps while offline: sent twice, it runs once and the repeat gets the first answer back (since 1.15).

post.summary: Open transfers per type and default location
post.description: Module `mobile_stock`, feature `stock` (capability `view`).
Lists, buttons (`object:button_validate`...) and wizards: record service `picking`.

post.summary: Scan a product on a transfer
post.description: +1 (or the packaging quantity) on the first line of the product still missing quantities. A product not on the transfer is refused (400). A lot / serial label: +1 of that lot. The barcode of a tracked product counts nothing and returns `lot_needed_move_id`.

post.summary: Set the quantity of one lot / serial number on a line
post.description: `quantity: 0` removes the lot. The first lot entered replaces the lots Odoo reserved. Serial numbers: 1 each, once per transfer. Unknown lot names only when `new_lots`.

post.summary: Lots of a product in stock
post.description: Under `location_id` (default: every internal location), most stock first. `available`: not reserved.

post.summary: Set the counted quantity of a line
Count a product in a location
post.description: Capability `count`. The count waits in Inventory > Physical Inventory; `apply: true` (capability `apply`, inventory administrators) updates the stock right away. `location_id` defaults to the warehouse stock.

lot.description: Required for tracked products; an unknown lot is created.

post.description: Module `mobile_delivery_tracking`, feature `trips` (capability `drive`).
Only the driver's own trips (dispatchers follow trips in Odoo).
One trip on the road at a time. The phone then records and sends its positions.

post.summary: Finish the trip on the road
Mark a stop arrived / delivered / not delivered
post.description: The trip must be on the road. `failed` needs a `note` (the reason).
`version` is the one of `tracking.consent`. 409 `conflict`: the text changed, read it again. Needed once per version, before the first sharing.

Opens the session in which the server accepts positions of this trip. Never started by the server or by starting the trip. 400 `user_error` when the text of `tracking.consent` was not accepted yet (`/trips/consent`). Refused if the company switched sharing off or the trip is not on the road. The driver's other open session (another trip or phone) ends. `profile` is used only if the settings let the driver choose; the values come back in `sharing`.
Harmless when no session is open. `reason` is kept (default `manual`). Sessions also end by themselves: the trip ends, `max_hours` passes, another trip starts sharing.

post.summary: Add a photo as proof of delivery
post.description: The trip must be on the road (or finished less than 12 hours ago: offline queue). The type of the file is read from its first bytes, not from what the phone says. Refused beyond `tracking.proof` limits. Videos: `/trips/stop/proof/upload`. Marking a stop `done` is refused while its rule (`proof_rule`) is not met.

client_id.description: Chosen by the phone (up to 64 characters): sending the same one again changes nothing.

data.description: The photo, base64 (JPEG, PNG or WebP; the phone compresses it to about 1 MB, at most 10 MB).

post.summary: Add a photo or a video as proof of delivery (multipart)
post.description: The same as `/trips/stop/proof` for big files: `multipart/form-data` with the text fields `trip_id`, `stop_id`, `client_id`, optional `kind`, `taken_at`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `duration` (seconds, videos) and the file in the part `file` (MP4 or MOV for videos, at most `tracking.proof.max_video_mb` and `max_video_seconds`).

Sent by the phone's background service. One INSERT per batch; positions older than the trip's last one (a retry) are left out. Accepted only while a sharing session of the driver is open for the trip (`/trips/share/start`), and for 12 hours after the end of the trip for positions recorded before it (offline queue).

points.description: At most 500: [unix seconds, latitude, longitude, accuracy m or null, speed km/h or null].

E401.description: Authentication failed (HTML body when the token is invalid)

code.description:
- `bad_request`: Malformed request (missing parameter, unknown model or scope...). HTTP 400.
- `user_error`: Business error raised by Odoo (UserError / ValidationError), already translated. HTTP 400.
- `database_required`: No database could be selected for the request. HTTP 400.
- `database_mismatch`: The `db` sent differs from the database the request is routed to. HTTP 400.
- `invalid_credentials`: Wrong login or password. HTTP 401.
- `totp_required`: The account uses two-factor authentication: send `totp_code`. HTTP 401.
- `totp_invalid`: Wrong two-factor code. HTTP 401.
- `access_denied`: Odoo AccessDenied. HTTP 401.
- `unauthorized`: Unknown device token. HTTP 401.
- `access_error`: Odoo AccessError (ACL / record rules). HTTP 403.
- `feature_denied`: The user has no access to this feature/capability (see `access`). HTTP 403.
- `not_internal_user`: Portal/public users cannot use the API. HTTP 403.
- `missing`: Record not found or deleted. HTTP 404.
- `conflict`: The record changed since the `version` sent: reload it. HTTP 409.
- `server_error`: Unexpected server error (details in the Odoo log). HTTP 500.

message.description: Human readable, in the request language when Odoo translates it.

error.message: This record was changed by someone else meanwhile.

FieldValue.description:
Value of a field in "mobile format":
- many2one: `[id, "name"]` or `false`
- many2many / one2many: `[[id, "name"], ...]`
- date: `"YYYY-MM-DD"`, datetime: `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"` (UTC), or `false`
- binary (widget image / signature, full form only): `true`/`false` (the data is never sent); to write, `{"datas": base64}` (photo) or `{"strokes": [[[x, y], ...], ...], "width", "height"}` (drawn signature, turned into a PNG by the server). `true` = unchanged.
- others: plain JSON value. When writing, a many2one may also be sent as its id.

site_id.description: database.uuid: identifies the site in push payloads.

features.description: Mobile features installed on the site (core, activities, timeoff, attendance, expense, trips...).

language_formats.description: How each enabled language writes dates, times and numbers (since API 1.16), by Odoo language code. The app shows dates the way the company set them in Settings > Translations > Languages.

thousands_sep.description: Empty when the language has none.

provider.description: firebase: the company's own Firebase project (free, Android only); gateway: the push gateway (Android and iPhone).

Public settings of the Android app in the Firebase project.

Checksum of the picture behind the login form (Settings > Mobile > Branding), false when none is set. Download `/login_background` again only when it changes. Since API 1.17.

Access.description: What THIS user may do: `{feature: {capability: allowed}}`. A feature is absent when nothing is allowed.

device_uid.description: Stable id of the device/integration. A new login with the same id revokes the previous token.

db.description: Optional check: must equal the database the request is routed to.

totp_code.description: Required when the account has two-factor authentication.

device_token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Shown only once; the server keeps a SHA-256.

poll_interval.description: Seconds the client should wait before the next check.

invisible.description: Evaluated server-side for this record (view modifiers + customer modules).

extra.description: Customer extension field (not part of the native layout).

key.description: Pass back to the `action` endpoint, e.g. `object:action_approve`.

oneOf.description: Opaque record version for change detection and conflict-safe saves.

buttons.description: Only the buttons this user may run on this record now; others are refused.

FormSpec.description: A form computed server-side from the real Odoo form view (inherited views and groups applied).

core.description: Fields the client lays out natively.

extra.description: Customer extension fields, in display order.

oneOf.description: line_section / line_note: a heading row.

total.description: Number of lines (rows are capped at 200).

states.description: Modifiers per cell: they may differ from one line to the next.

editable.description: The user may write the record (rights and record rules).

FullFormSpec.description: Every field of the Odoo form view, editable as the view allows; html as plain text (since 1.14).

ActionDone.description: The button ran; reload the record.

ActionNotification.description: Show a message to the user.

oneOf.description: Ask this before pressing.

key.description: announcements, attendance, activities, shortcuts, kpis, tiles, apps, or list:<id> (record list).

sizes.description: Layouts the block offers; the first is the default.

activity_id.description: The next step, false without one.

open.description: Opportunities of the scope that are not won.

lines.description: What the employee reads, in the order of the payslip (company contributions are left out).

sections.description: Sections in display order; those without a card the user may see are left out.

previous.description: The same stretch before: yesterday, or the same days of last month.

total.description: Counts out of a whole (people checked in out of all employees).

trend.description: Amount per month, oldest first (6 months).

tone.description: Something needs attention when the number is not zero (late deliveries).

tabs.description: Bottom tabs of the role layout: home, then activities, notifications, attendance, timeoff, expenses, quotations, purchases, employees (those the user may open), then settings. null: the app's default tabs. API 1.10.

tiles.description: Feature tiles in this order (label false = the app's own); null = none configured, the app shows every tile the user may use.

Figure per week/month, oldest first (API 1.12).

currency_field.description: Monetary columns: field of `values` holding the currency.

group.description: Filters of a group are OR-ed, groups are AND-ed.

filters.description: Domain filters of the search view.

Changes with the photo (cache key).

managers.description: Management chain, from the top down to the direct manager.

body.description: Plain text, at most 400 characters (subtype name for tracking messages).

reasons.description: Reasons for the next check in/out when the company uses them (OCA hr_attendance_reason), else empty.
